author: Durk
install_msg: Thanks for installing DurkMod! Note: unload the core Mod and Filter cogs first, their `ban` and `filter` commands conflict with this one.
name: DurkMod
short: A ban command that's actually a timeout, plus per-user sentiment filtering.
description: Provides a `ban` command that announces a ban but only times the member out for the given duration. Also provides a `filter` command that runs a user's messages through SentimentFilter in every channel, permanently or for a set time.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the IDs of users an admin has filtered, with when the filter expires. Their messages are sent to OpenRouter through SentimentFilter for classification.
